user_scenario: The shooter chases a target while both run around the same rock, block or tree
default: CurvedAimEnabled=true; Prediction toggle returns to original ILM when disabled
safety_of_prediction: Only a stable fitted orbit with current samples and known native projectile speed/range overrides ILM. Stops, reversals, teleports, reused IDs and stale data fall back. Same-ID reconnect invalidates the shooter-entity metadata cache.
limits: Prepared trajectories and radius-38 intersections, not a measured live-server hit rate
No obstacle collision or projectile spread simulation
No measured server latency; sample arrival age is included
Browser/device FPS of the user was not measured
